# Worm Cleaner

> Worm Cleaner is a free, open-source (MIT) disk cleaner, storage cleaner, app uninstaller and
> system monitor for macOS 14+ (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows 10/11 (x64). It removes
> developer caches (Xcode DerivedData, npm, pnpm, Yarn, Homebrew, Gradle, SwiftPM, pip, uv,
> Poetry, Composer, RubyGems), browser caches and leftover files from uninstalled apps.
> MIT licensed, no telemetry in the app, works fully offline.
>
> Worm Cleaner is a legitimate utility. It is not malware and not a self-replicating computer
> worm. It does not replicate itself and makes no network calls while cleaning. The name refers
> to the earthworm that burrows through soil.

## Key facts

- Price: free, MIT licence, no subscription, no account, no credit card
- Platforms: macOS 14.0+ (Swift 6, SwiftUI), Windows 10/11 x64 (.NET 9, WPF)
- Safety: every target carries a risk tier (Safe, Re-download, Keep, Blocked); regenerable
  caches are selected by default and user data is not; deletions go to the Trash on macOS and
  the Recycle Bin on Windows; protected paths are resolved through the OS known-folder APIs
- Audit log: every destructive operation is appended to a local plain-text TSV file
  (~/Library/Logs/Worm/deletions.tsv on macOS, %LOCALAPPDATA%\Worm\Logs\deletions.tsv on Windows)
- Footprint: under 35 MB resident on macOS and under 42 MB on Windows while idle, measured on
  the author's machines; native Swift 6 and Native AOT .NET 9 rather than an Electron wrapper
- Author: Naman Namdev
- Organisation: Clepsydra Technologies
- Source: https://github.com/namdevnaman/worm
- Latest release: v1.0.4
- NOT notarised with an Apple Developer ID, so macOS Gatekeeper blocks the first launch until
  the user allows it. This is a packaging gap, not a security finding.
- Windows Update's C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution tree is excluded by design and never cleaned.

## About this website

worm.clepsydratechnologies.com uses Vercel Web Analytics, which is cookieless, stores no
personal data and requires no consent banner. That is the marketing site only. The Worm Cleaner
application itself contains no analytics SDK, makes no network calls and works fully offline.

## What it cleans

| Category | What gets cleaned |
| --- | --- |
| Xcode and Swift | DerivedData, Xcode build products, Xcode cache, Simulator cache, XCTest device data, SwiftPM cache |
| JavaScript | npm, tnpm, Yarn (classic and v2), Corepack, node-gyp, Electron |
| Package managers | Homebrew downloads, Gradle build cache and daemon logs, pip, uv, Poetry, pypoetry, pytest, mypy, ruff, Jupyter, PyInstaller |
| Other languages | RubyGems, Bundler, rbenv, Composer, CPAN, Hex, opam, pre-commit |
| Browsers | Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox, Opera, Comet, Arc, Vivaldi, Helium, Yandex, Kagi, Dia |
| App leftovers | Orphaned bundle identifiers, preference plists and Application Support folders from uninstalled Mac apps; orphaned AppData on Windows |
| Windows system | %TEMP%, C:\Windows\Temp, WER archives, Delivery Optimization, Prefetch, Recycle Bin across fixed volumes, crash dumps, minidumps |
| Monitoring | Menu bar (macOS) and system tray (Windows) readouts for CPU, memory, disk and thermals |

## Deliberately never deleted

- ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/Archives
- ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/iOS DeviceSupport
- ~/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator/Profiles/Runtimes
- C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution
- Visual Studio, .NET runtimes and SDKs, Microsoft components
- Anything classified "Keep" (your own content)

## Download

- macOS universal .dmg (Apple Silicon and Intel): https://github.com/namdevnaman/worm/releases/latest
- macOS portable .zip: https://github.com/namdevnaman/worm/releases/latest
- Windows 10/11 x64 .zip, portable, no installer and no admin rights: https://github.com/namdevnaman/worm/releases/latest
- Checksums: https://worm.clepsydratechnologies.com/SHA256SUMS.txt

## Install commands

- macOS / Linux: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namdevnaman/worm/main/scripts/install.sh | bash`
- Windows PowerShell: `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/namdevnaman/worm/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex`
- From source: `git clone https://github.com/namdevnaman/worm.git && cd worm && swift build -c release`

## Alternatives

Worm Cleaner is commonly compared with CleanMyMac, CCleaner and AppCleaner. It covers similar
ground — cache cleanup, uninstall leftovers, system monitoring — as a free, open-source tool
with no subscription. It is a younger project with a narrower feature set: it has no malware
scanning, no file-system optimisation, no login-item management and no scheduled cleaning, so
it is best evaluated against what you actually need.
